_about: Public-domain Johann Peter Lange (1802-1884, Bonn theologian) in English for the Word Hoard: The Life of the Lord Jesus Christ, ed. Marcus Dods (6 vols, Edinburgh, 1864), his Commentary on St Matthew and St Mark, tr. Alfred Edersheim and W. B. Pope (3 vols, 1861-1862), and the volumes of the Schaff Commentary he wrote alone (Matthew, Mark, John, Genesis, Exodus and Numbers, 1865-1899), from Internet Archive scans. The Schaff volumes by other hands are not on this shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
